notes.title: Deathtrap Dungeon: The Golden Room Reveal
notes.content:
[url=https://www.walesinteractive.com/thegoldenroom]Deathtrap Dungeon: The Golden Room[/url] is an interactive movie based on Ian Livingstone's multi-million selling classic gamebook. Become the adventurer on their quest to the Golden Room. 

[b]Coming to all major gaming platforms in 2022. [/b]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1623800?utm_source=WI-SteamNews&utm_campaign=Reveal]Demo now available on Steam[/url] and Xbox consoles.[/b]

[previewyoutube=AaFY2IflTgU;full][/previewyoutube]

As the Brave Adventurer faces many foes, you must tread carefully on your quest through to the Golden Room. Face the Trial-Master of the Dungeon Vhaidra and her tricks and traps as she tests your skill. Beware of the Bloodbeast lurking behind any door.

Decide wisely, or find yourself in a Deathtrap.

• One story, several different paths, endings… and deaths.
• A completely live-action, cinematic interactive fantasy adventure movie.
• Featuring the same CGI Virtual Set technology as used in The Mandalorian.
• From the studio that brought you The Complex, Five Dates and Maid of Sker.
• Starring Georgia Hirst (Five Dates, Vikings) and Marcus Fraser (Transformers: The Last Knight)
• A part of the Clwstwr R&D project. Clwstwr is an innovation programme for the South Wales screen sector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305446/71fefab3aa2c65831b285ceedc429f7069f909b6.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1251960/Deathtrap_Dungeon_The_Golden_Room/

Also announced today (with a Steam Next Fest demo!) for the very first time is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1623900?utm_source=WI-SteamNews&utm_campaign=Reveal&utm_medium=DeathtrapPost]Night Book[/url], our interactive psychological thriller about an online interpreter who is tricked into reading an ancient book that summons a demon into her home.
